remarks: Enjoy sweeping city views, stunning sunsets, and the comfort of this refreshed 2-bedroom, 1-bath corner unit in a high-rise Stamford condo. Filled with natural light, the unit features tile flooring, fresh paint, and an open-concept living and dining area-ideal for entertaining. A private (not shared) balcony offers beautiful views of downtown Stamford, while both bedrooms enjoy abundant sunlight. Additional highlights include hallway storage and a full bath. The secure, gated building provides 24/7 security, two elevators, laundry facilities, basement storage, visitor parking, a fitness center, and an outdoor pool. One assigned parking space is included, and the monthly HOA covers heat, hot water, gas cooking, basic cable, sewer, snow removal, and on-site property management. Perfectly located near restaurants, bars, shops, Tully Health Center, Metro-North, and I-95, this condo offers exceptional value, convenience, and urban lifestyle in the heart of Stamford.
